settings.heading: Every Box Plants a Mangrove
settings.text:
Along the coast of Tarakan, Indonesia, our Black Tiger Shrimp are raised within living mangrove forests.

For every Seatopia box ordered, we plant one mangrove tree to support the coastal ecosystems that make exceptional seafood possible.

settings.heading: The Forest and the Farm Are One

settings.text: In Tarakan, Indonesia, Black Tiger Shrimp are raised in low-density ponds woven through living mangrove forests.
Natural tidal cycles support an ecosystem where mangrove roots help stabilize shorelines, filter water, and provide habitat for marine life.
It’s a different approach to aquaculture, one that recognizes the relationship between healthy ecosystems and exceptional seafood.

settings.question: Can I customize my box?
settings.answer:
We are essentially a farmers market for artisanal aquaculture. In that sense, our Seatopia curated boxes are like a CSA box. We offer our curated boxes as a way to highlight what is seasonally available and introduce our members to new seafood and farm partners they might be interested in. So, they cannot be customized. 

But we do offer custom boxes! Members can order a custom box through the a la cart section of our website. Subscription members can mix and match items in their portal and take advantage of member-only items and offers.

settings.question: Do I have to subscribe to place an order?
settings.answer:
No! But becoming a subscriber is the best way to support aquaculture farmers raising fish the right way. 

Your subscription helps us with planning harvest timelines and scheduling ocean freight, helping us move the industry away from unsustainable practices of flying fresh fish around the world. Subscribers also have early access to preferred pricing, exclusive add-ons and limited time offers. 

You will never be locked in to a subscription - you may change the order, the frequency or cancel anytime.

settings.question: Do you offer discounts?
settings.answer:
As a general rule, we do not offer discounts, aside from a small thank you for first time customers. We offer the same incentive if you find us through one of our affiliate friends or supporters. Both are only available to first time customers. 

Rather than ask our members to search the internet for discounts and coupons, we always offer the lowest prices we can. 

The best way to save is by becoming a monthly subscriber. Our subscription members receive a small price incentive for helping us to reliably and predictably support artisan, regenerative aquaculture.

settings.question: What about antibiotics?
settings.answer:
When we choose farm partners, we look for farms that manage animal health without antibiotics. Many of our farms have no need for them by design, which is the case with scallops and with many of our land-based recirculating farms. Others have transitioned away entirely: our Atlantic salmon partner, Bakkafrost, has used zero antibiotics since 2004.

In the rare case of a significant animal health threat, some of our farms reserve the right to use therapeutic antibiotics under veterinary guidance. If that happens, the fish are held for a mandatory withdrawal period so that no trace remains before harvest. Antibiotics on the World Health Organization's list of drugs critically important to human medicine are not permitted.

settings.question: What is a portion?
settings.answer:
We consider one portion to be 4 to 6 ounces of cooked fish, which matches the FDA's definition of a serving of seafood. That is the guideline behind how much fish by weight goes into a box described in servings. Some of our fish, such as king salmon, come in larger pieces of 7.5 to 8.5 oz, so a single piece can be two nutritional servings.

Many of our members work with a nutritionist or practitioner, or use an app, to decide what they should be eating for protein, fats or specific nutrients. The right amount and frequency for you is personal, and our job is to give you the data that makes the decision easy.
